Adversarially verify this code-review finding from the M12 diff. Read the actual code (git diff main...HEAD + the file) and try to REFUTE it. Default to isReal=false if it's a false positive, pre-existing, out of scope, or already handled.

Lens: correctness
Severity: high
File: app/(customer)/account/page.tsx (Receipts section — payments.map(...) → href={`/account/receipt/${p.booking_id}`})
Title: Receipt download links 404 for any booking without a completed session
Detail: The Receipts section renders a "Download receipt" link for EVERY payment row returned by listCustomerPayments (no status filter). But a confirmed/upcoming booking already has a payments row with status "authorized" (created by payments.authorizeHold in app/(customer)/actions.ts at booking time, before any session exists). The receipt route at app/(customer)/account/receipt/[bookingId]/route.ts does `const [booking, session] = await Promise.all([getBooking, getSessionByBooking]); if (!booking || ... || !session) return 404`. Since getSessionByBooking returns null until the session is completed, every authorized-but-not-yet-completed booking produces a visible receipt link that returns HTTP 404 when clicked. A customer who just booked an upcoming session will see a broken download.
Suggestion: Only render receipt links for payments tied to completed sessions (e.g. filter to status === "captured", or to bookings that have a completed session), or make the receipt route gracefully handle the no-session case (return a partial/authorized receipt instead of 404).
